document_title: Emotion Recognition Archetypes for Vision-Language Models

emotions.definition: Fond feelings; love; tenderness

archetypes.name: Parental Tenderness
archetypes.core_difference: Stark physical size contrast and protective, asymmetrical caregiving posture between an adult and a small child
archetypes.visual_elements: Adult, infant or toddler, cradling arms, gentle touch, soft blankets, warm natural light, nursery or domestic interior, protective embrace, peaceful vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a parent gently cradling a sleeping newborn baby wrapped in a soft blanket, looking down with a peaceful and protective expression in a warmly lit room

archetypes.name: Romantic Intimacy
archetypes.core_difference: Extreme facial proximity, mirrored body language, and romantic tension between two adult partners in an atmospheric setting
archetypes.visual_elements: Two adults, foreheads touching, holding hands, closed eyes, sunset or dim ambient lighting, blurred background, intimate embrace, romantic vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a young couple locked in a close embrace at sunset, their foreheads lightly touching and eyes closed, standing together against a brightly colored, gently blurred evening sky

archetypes.name: The Human-Animal Bond
archetypes.core_difference: Introduces non-human anatomy (pets), highlighting physical textures of fur and interspecies comfort between human and animal
archetypes.visual_elements: Person, dog or cat, thick fur, petting, kneeling, grassy park or living room floor, casual clothing, relaxed posture, joyful and comforting vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a casually dressed person kneeling in a vibrant green park, tightly hugging a large, fluffy dog that is leaning into the embrace with a relaxed, happy posture

archetypes.name: Platonic Camaraderie
archetypes.core_difference: Lively, open group dynamic with peers engaging in energetic, casual physical touch, contrasting with closed, one-on-one poses
archetypes.visual_elements: Group of young adults, laughing faces, casual streetwear, arms around shoulders, leaning against each other, urban street or coffee shop, bright daylight, energetic vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a diverse group of laughing friends walking down a bright city street, casually leaning on each other with their arms wrapped securely around one another's shoulders

emotions.definition: Intense displeasure or rage; furious; resentful

archetypes.name: Vehicular Frustration (Road Rage)
archetypes.core_difference: Aggressive gestures and facial tension isolated within the tight, metallic confines of a vehicle
archetypes.visual_elements: Driver, car interior, steering wheel, white-knuckle grip, yelling, blurred traffic background, daylight, clenched jaw, aggressive vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a furious driver sitting in heavy traffic, aggressively gripping the steering wheel with clenched fists and yelling through the windshield with a tense, red face

archetypes.name: Inanimate Object Conflict (Tech Breakdown)
archetypes.core_difference: Isolated human frustration directed at an unyielding inanimate object within a sterile, indoor corporate environment
archetypes.visual_elements: Office worker, computer monitor, desk, fluorescent lighting, raised fists, papers scattered, frustrated facial expression, destructive energy
archetypes.text_query: An image showing an angry office worker in a cubicle, violently raising both fists to slam them onto a desk in front of a blank computer monitor and scattered papers

archetypes.name: Collective Outrage (Street Protest)
archetypes.core_difference: Vocal, unified anger within a large, dynamic crowd outdoors, emphasizing scale and shared rebellious emotion
archetypes.visual_elements: Large crowd, city street, painted cardboard signs, raised fists, open mouths shouting, megaphones, daylight, chaotic and defiant vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a dense crowd of protesters marching down a city street, holding up large painted signs and shouting aggressively with raised fists and intense, furious expressions

archetypes.name: Interpersonal Hostility (Domestic Argument)
archetypes.core_difference: Intimate, face-to-face conflict, mirrored aggressive body language, and close physical proximity between two individuals in a private setting
archetypes.visual_elements: Two adults, living room or kitchen, pointing fingers, rigid posture, narrowed eyes, evening ambient lighting, domestic backdrop, hostile vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing two people standing face-to-face in a dimly lit living room, intensely arguing with rigid postures, narrowed eyes, and one person aggressively pointing a finger at the other

emotions.definition: Bothered by something or someone; irritated; impatient; frustrated

archetypes.name: The Endless Queue (Impatient Waiting)
archetypes.core_difference: Passive, static frustration of being delayed in a crowded public transit or retail space
archetypes.visual_elements: Commuter, wristwatch, long line of people, sighing, crossed arms, train station or airport, static, impatient vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a tired commuter standing in a long, crowded airport line, aggressively checking their wristwatch with a heavy sigh and crossed arms

archetypes.name: Auditory Intrusion (Sensory Overload)
archetypes.core_difference: Physical reaction to an invisible environmental nuisance, using body to block out sensory input
archetypes.visual_elements: Person in pajamas, pillow over head, hands pressing ears, bedroom, morning light, wincing face, irritated vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a frustrated person lying in bed in the morning light, squeezing a pillow tightly over their head and ears with a wincing expression to block out loud noise

archetypes.name: The Unwanted Conversation (Social Irritation)
archetypes.core_difference: Subtle, one-sided interpersonal friction through asymmetric body language and facial micro-expressions, like the classic eye roll
archetypes.visual_elements: Two people, office breakroom or cafe, one talking eagerly, the other rolling eyes, resting chin on hand, looking away, awkward vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of an annoyed woman sitting at a small cafe table, rolling her eyes and resting her chin heavily on her hand while the person across from her talks enthusiastically

archetypes.name: Everyday Nuisance (Fine-Motor Frustration)
archetypes.core_difference: Close-up, isolating struggle with a minor, stubborn inanimate object that requires tedious effort to fix
archetypes.visual_elements: Close-up on hands, tangled wires or earphones, furrowed brow, desk top, tight grip, exasperated vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a close-up of a person's hands tightly gripping a massive knot of tangled cables, with their deeply furrowed, exasperated brow visible in the slightly blurred background

emotions.definition: State of looking forward; hoping on or getting prepared for possible future events

archetypes.name: The Starting Line (Athletic Tension)
archetypes.core_difference: Extreme physical tension, coiled energy, and athletic readiness in a stark outdoor or stadium environment
archetypes.visual_elements: Sprinters, starting blocks, red track, crouched posture, tense muscles, focused gaze, daylight or stadium lights, high-stakes and explosive vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of sprinters crouched at the starting blocks on a red athletic track, their muscles tense and eyes locked forward in eager readiness just before the starting gun

archetypes.name: The Oven Watch (Domestic Culinary Wait)
archetypes.core_difference: Warm, low-stakes domestic scene illuminated by the specific, intimate glow of an artificial appliance light
archetypes.visual_elements: Child, oven window, warm glowing orange light, hands pressed to glass, baking cookies, dim kitchen interior, cozy and eager vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a young child kneeling on a kitchen floor, pressing their hands eagerly against the glowing glass door of an oven while watching cookies rise inside

archetypes.name: Backstage Peeking (Performance Readiness)
archetypes.core_difference: Dramatic, high-contrast lighting and the literal threshold between a hidden dark space and a public, brightly lit arena
archetypes.visual_elements: Performer, heavy red velvet curtain, backstage shadows, bright stage spotlight, peeking out, wide-eyed expression, nervous excitement vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of an actor standing in a dark backstage area, nervously but excitedly peeking through a small gap in a heavy red velvet curtain toward a brightly lit stage

archetypes.name: The Sealed Envelope (High-Stakes News)
archetypes.core_difference: Tight focus on interaction with a small, flat object, emphasizing psychological weight and facial micro-expressions right before life-changing news is revealed
archetypes.visual_elements: Young adult, thick paper envelope, half-pulled letter, hovering thumbs, held breath, wide eyes, living room sofa, quiet and suspenseful vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a teenager sitting on a living room sofa, holding their breath with wide eyes as they slowly and carefully pull a folded letter out of a torn envelope

emotions.definition: Feeling disgust, dislike, repulsion; feeling hate

archetypes.name: Olfactory/Gustatory Disgust (Spoiled Food)
archetypes.core_difference: Isolated facial micro-expression reacting to a bad smell or taste from a specific consumable object
archetypes.visual_elements: Person, wrinkled nose, pinched face, holding moldy food or stinky garbage at arm's length, kitchen setting, grossed-out vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a person in a kitchen holding a piece of heavily moldy fruit at arm's length, pinching their nose shut and grimacing with a deeply wrinkled face

archetypes.name: Tactile Repulsion (The 'Ew' Factor)
archetypes.core_difference: Full-body, sudden recoiling motion and defensive posture away from a small, creepy, or slimy physical stimulus
archetypes.visual_elements: Person, shrinking back, hands raised defensively to chest, looking down, spider or slimy texture, bathroom or outdoor setting, recoiling vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a person in a brightly lit bathroom violently recoiling and pulling their hands tightly back against their chest while staring down at a large bug on the floor

archetypes.name: Interpersonal Contempt (Social Dislike)
archetypes.core_difference: Cold, psychological dislike directed at another human, utilizing closed-off body language and a subtle sneer rather than an extreme physical reaction
archetypes.visual_elements: Two adults, office or party environment, glaring, sneering lip, side-eye, crossed arms, turning shoulders away, cold and hostile vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of two people at a crowded social event, where one person is actively turning their shoulders away and shooting a cold, glaring side-eye with a sneering lip at the other

archetypes.name: Phobic Avoidance (Gaze Aversion)
archetypes.core_difference: Intentional gaze aversion and intense physical cringing away from an impending, uncomfortable but sterile procedure
archetypes.visual_elements: Patient, medical professional, syringe or cotton swab, turning head sharply away, squeezing eyes completely shut, clinical lighting, tense and avoidant vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a tense patient in a sterile doctor's office, squeezing their eyes completely shut and turning their head sharply away to avoid looking at an approaching syringe

emotions.definition: Feeling of being certain; conviction that an outcome will be favorable; encouraged; proud

archetypes.name: Executive Command (Public Speaking)
archetypes.core_difference: Formal authority, polished presentation, and asymmetrical power dynamic of one person comfortably holding the attention of a large crowd
archetypes.visual_elements: Speaker, stage spotlight, tailored business suit, upright posture, open hand gestures, microphone, blurred audience background, authoritative and proud vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of an executive in a tailored suit standing tall on a brightly lit stage, making open, relaxed hand gestures and smiling assuredly while confidently addressing a blurred audience

archetypes.name: Athletic Mastery (Mid-Action Peak)
archetypes.core_difference: Physical conviction and dynamic movement, capturing the exact moment a subject demonstrates absolute, fearless control over their body in a high-stakes physical environment
archetypes.visual_elements: Athlete, mid-air leap, sports gear, relaxed facial muscles despite extreme physical exertion, clear sky or stadium, dynamic low angle, fearless vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a skateboarder suspended mid-air during a complex trick, maintaining a perfectly relaxed, intensely focused expression of absolute certainty against a bright blue sky

archetypes.name: Quiet Self-Assurance (Casual Portrait)
archetypes.core_difference: Relies entirely on subtle micro-expressions, relaxed resting posture, and direct, unflinching eye contact in a low-stakes, everyday environment
archetypes.visual_elements: Adult, casual clothing, leaning back, hands resting easily, direct eye contact, slight smirk, natural lighting, coffee shop or living room, unbothered and secure vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a casually dressed person sitting in a sunlit cafe, leaning back comfortably with relaxed shoulders and looking directly into the camera lens with a subtle, unbothered smirk

archetypes.name: Intellectual Conviction (The Problem Solver)
archetypes.core_difference: Moment of mental clarity and pride in a technical or academic setting, focusing on interaction with complex data or tools
archetypes.visual_elements: Scientist or student, large whiteboard filled with equations, dry-erase marker, turning around, beaming smile, raised chin, bright classroom or lab, proud and encouraged vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a smiling student standing in a brightly lit classroom, holding a marker in front of a whiteboard covered in complex math, looking back with a proud, accomplished posture

emotions.definition: Feeling that something is wrong or reprehensible; contempt; hostile

archetypes.name: The Formal Reprimand
archetypes.core_difference: Hierarchical authority dynamics within a stark, professional environment, characterized by direct, top-down hostility
archetypes.visual_elements: Office desk, business suits, pointing index finger, furrowed brow, rigid posture, intense eye contact, cold and clinical vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a stern executive in a modern corporate office, leaning intensely over a desk with a deeply furrowed brow and pointing a finger aggressively toward someone off-camera

archetypes.name: Public Social Judgment
archetypes.core_difference: Passive-aggressive disapproval from strangers in a casual, public setting, relying on subtle, avoidant body language rather than direct confrontation
archetypes.visual_elements: Busy street or cafe, casual clothing, bystanders, tightly crossed arms, side-eye glances, whispering behind a hand, physical distancing, judgmental vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of two people sitting in a busy outdoor cafe, leaning away with their arms tightly crossed, casting a sharp, contemptuous side-eye glare at an unseen passerby

archetypes.name: Domestic Disgust
archetypes.core_difference: Intimate, close-quarters relational tension with overt facial expressions of contempt and disgust in a familiar, personal space
archetypes.visual_elements: Messy living room or kitchen, casual homewear, sneering upper lip, hands resting on hips, rolling eyes, turned shoulders, tense and exhausted vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a person standing in a dimly lit kitchen wearing casual clothes, rolling their eyes with a pronounced sneer of disgust and turning their shoulders away from an argument

archetypes.name: Oppositional Hostility
archetypes.core_difference: Active, aggressive, and overt hostility within a chaotic, crowded outdoor setting, often tied to ideological or group conflict
archetypes.visual_elements: Urban street, protest signs, barricades, dense crowd, glaring intensely, shouting mouth, gripping hands, confrontational and aggressive vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a person in a dense, chaotic outdoor crowd, gripping a cardboard sign tightly while leaning forward to aggressively glare and shout with absolute contempt

emotions.definition: Feeling not interested in the main event of the surrounding; indifferent; bored; distracted

archetypes.name: The Social Gathering Isolation
archetypes.core_difference: Chaotic, dimly lit, high-energy social environment contrasted with a static, artificially illuminated subject retreating into a digital space
archetypes.visual_elements: Dimmed party lights, blurred dancing crowd, single subject sitting on a couch, glowing smartphone screen illuminating the face, slouched posture, blank facial expression, heavy vignette
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a person sitting alone on a couch at a lively house party, staring blankly at a glowing smartphone screen while a blurred crowd dances and talks in the background

archetypes.name: The Corporate Meeting Daydreamer
archetypes.core_difference: Structured, brightly lit, formal environment focusing on physical presence versus mental absence, indicated by broken eye contact with a clear focal point
archetypes.visual_elements: Conference room table, harsh fluorescent lighting, colleagues in business attire looking forward, whiteboard presenter, one subject resting chin in hand, looking out a window, doodling on a notepad
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a corporate boardroom meeting where one employee rests their chin on their hand, staring absently out the window, completely ignoring the enthusiastic speaker presenting at the whiteboard

archetypes.name: The Unimpressed Stadium Spectator
archetypes.core_difference: Extreme scale and collective emotion, emphasizing disconnection through a subject performing an entirely out-of-place, low-energy activity amid mass hysteria
archetypes.visual_elements: Outdoor stadium seating, bright daylight, massive crowd with hands in the air, team colors, cheering, single subject sitting with arms crossed, yawning, reading a paperback book, neutral attire
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a bored spectator yawning and looking down at a book while sitting in the stands of a brightly lit sports stadium, surrounded by thousands of cheering fans waving flags

archetypes.name: The Distracted Dinner Date
archetypes.core_difference: Intimate, close-up, two-person composition highlighting asymmetrical emotional engagement and micro-expressions of indifference rather than full physical withdrawal
archetypes.visual_elements: Candlelit restaurant table, warm low lighting, wine glasses, one subject talking enthusiastically with hand gestures, second subject looking downward or away, flat expression, aimlessly playing with silverware
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a couple at a candlelit restaurant table, where one person speaks animatedly while the other stares downward with an indifferent expression, aimlessly pushing food around their plate with a fork

emotions.definition: Nervous; worried; upset; anxious; tense; pressured; alarmed

archetypes.name: The Late-Night Deadline
archetypes.core_difference: Active, technology-induced stress, characterized by isolation, harsh lighting, and physical manifestation of being overwhelmed by an immediate task
archetypes.visual_elements: Glowing computer monitor, dark room, messy desk, stacked paperwork, empty coffee cups, rubbing temples, tight jaw, screen glare, exhaustion
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a tense person sitting alone in a dark office, illuminated only by the harsh glare of a computer monitor, surrounded by messy stacks of paper and empty coffee cups, rubbing their temples

archetypes.name: The Clinical Waiting Room
archetypes.core_difference: Passive, anticipatory anxiety in a sterile environment, focusing heavily on involuntary body language rather than engagement with a task
archetypes.visual_elements: Sterile white walls, row of plastic chairs, fluorescent overhead lighting, wringing hands together, bouncing leg, looking down, empty corridor, pale color palette
archetypes.text_query: An image showing an anxious individual sitting hunched over in a stark, brightly lit hospital waiting room, tightly wringing their hands together with a worried expression, staring blankly at the sterile linoleum floor

archetypes.name: The Public Spotlight
archetypes.core_difference: Single, highly exposed subject against a large, intimidating group, capturing the 'deer in headlights' social panic and alarm
archetypes.visual_elements: Wooden podium, microphone, blurred audience in the foreground/background, bright stage spotlight, sweating forehead, wide eyes, clutching crumpled notes, stiff and rigid posture
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a nervous speaker standing rigidly behind a wooden podium on a brightly lit stage, clutching crumpled notes tightly, looking out with wide, alarmed eyes at a large, out-of-focus crowd

archetypes.name: Domestic Financial Strain
archetypes.core_difference: Worry embedded within a relatable, everyday home setting, focusing on the quiet, crushing weight of personal and domestic responsibilities
archetypes.visual_elements: Wooden kitchen table, scattered opened envelopes, calculator, pen, head resting heavy in hands, dim overhead warm lamp, furrowed brow, muted domestic colors
archetypes.text_query: An image showing an upset person sitting at a dimly lit kitchen table covered with scattered bills and a calculator, resting their heavy head in their hands with a deeply furrowed, anxious brow

emotions.definition: Difficulty to understand or decide; thinking about different options

archetypes.name: The Consumer Choice (Retail Dilemma)
archetypes.core_difference: Physical comparison of tangible options in a bright, cluttered, everyday retail environment
archetypes.visual_elements: Supermarket aisle, two competing products, holding items in both hands, shifting gaze, furrowed brow, bright lighting, colorful packaging, everyday consumer vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a shopper standing in a brightly lit supermarket aisle, holding two different cereal boxes in each hand, looking back and forth between them with a furrowed brow and pursed lips

archetypes.name: Cognitive Overload (Academic/Technical Struggle)
archetypes.core_difference: Intellectual confusion when confronting abstract, dense information in an indoor study or work setting
archetypes.visual_elements: Cluttered desk, complex equations, computer monitor, rubbing temples, squinting eyes, late-night lighting, books, tense academic vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a student sitting at a cluttered desk late at night, rubbing their temples and squinting intensely at a laptop screen filled with dense, complicated lines of code

archetypes.name: Geographic Disorientation (The Lost Traveler)
archetypes.core_difference: Spatial and navigational confusion set in an expansive, dynamic outdoor or environmental context
archetypes.visual_elements: Urban intersection or trail fork, overlapping street signs, open physical map, scratching back of the head, looking upward or around, travel gear, wayfinding vibe
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a tourist wearing a backpack standing at a busy city intersection, scratching the back of their head while looking up at a confusing cluster of overlapping directional street signs

archetypes.name: Interpersonal Miscommunication (Social Bafflement)
archetypes.core_difference: Social and conversational confusion relying heavily on physical body language and facial expressions during a human interaction
archetypes.visual_elements: Two people, coffee shop or office, tilted head, one raised eyebrow, open palms facing up, skewed mouth, social tension vibe
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a person in a cafe having a conversation, with their head tilted, one eyebrow raised, and both palms facing upward in a bewildered gesture toward their friend across the table

emotions.definition: Feeling ashamed or guilty

archetypes.name: The Public Clumsiness Mishap
archetypes.core_difference: Sudden, highly visible physical accident in a busy social setting with reactive onlookers
archetypes.visual_elements: Spilled coffee, dropped cafeteria tray, crowded room, shocked onlookers pointing or staring, flushed cheeks, hands covering mouth, awkward apologizing posture
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a visibly flustered person in a crowded cafe dropping a tray of coffees, with hands covering their face in shock while surrounding customers stare awkwardly at the mess

archetypes.name: The Intimate Guilt / Caught Red-Handed
archetypes.core_difference: Quiet, indoor scene of being caught doing something wrong, emphasizing shrinking, submissive body language rather than sudden panic
archetypes.visual_elements: Broken vase on the floor, messy room, looking down at the ground, hands clasped behind the back, hunched shoulders, avoiding eye contact
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a person looking down at the floor with hunched shoulders and hands clasped behind their back, standing guiltily next to a shattered flower vase in a quiet living room

archetypes.name: The Public Speaking Freeze
archetypes.core_difference: Sheer isolation and exposure of a single subject isolated from a large crowd, highlighting performance anxiety
archetypes.visual_elements: Microphone, wooden podium, bright stage spotlight, blurred audience in the dark, sweating forehead, gripping podium tightly, wide deer-in-headlights eyes, stiff posture
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a nervous speaker standing frozen behind a podium under a bright stage spotlight, gripping the edges tightly with wide eyes and a flushed face, facing a blurred, expectant audience

archetypes.name: The Digital Faux Pas / Screen Realization
archetypes.core_difference: Modern, close-up scenario where the environment is irrelevant, and the embarrassment is entirely driven by interaction with a digital device
archetypes.visual_elements: Glowing laptop or smartphone screen, dark room, deep facepalm gesture, cringing facial expression, peering through fingers, illuminating blue screen light
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a person in a dimly lit room illuminated only by a laptop screen, intensely burying their face in their hands in a deep facepalm after making a digital mistake

emotions.definition: Paying attention to something; absorbed into something; curious; interested

archetypes.name: Deep Academic or Professional Focus
archetypes.core_difference: Solitary, static concentration using screens or literature in an indoor, structured environment
archetypes.visual_elements: Glowing laptop screen, stacks of books, leaning forward, resting chin on hand, furrowed brow, quiet library or home office, coffee mug, reading glasses
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a person sitting at a dimly lit desk, leaning closely toward a glowing laptop screen with furrowed brows and a hand on their chin, deeply absorbed in complex reading material

archetypes.name: Innocent Discovery and Curiosity
archetypes.core_difference: Raw, wide-eyed wonder and close physical proximity to a novel, physical object, typically set in nature
archetypes.visual_elements: Squatting or crouching posture, magnifying glass, hands reaching out, wide unblinking eyes, slightly parted lips, bright natural outdoor lighting, garden or forest setting
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a young child crouching in a sunny garden, holding a magnifying glass close to a green leaf, their eyes wide and lips slightly parted in pure fascination and curiosity

archetypes.name: Intimate Active Listening
archetypes.core_difference: Interpersonal, emotional engagement through body language and prolonged eye contact in a busy social setting
archetypes.visual_elements: Two people at a small table, leaning across the table, direct eye contact, subtle empathetic smile, nodding, blurred background of a busy cafe, warm indoor lighting
archetypes.text_query: A photo of an individual sitting in a busy coffee shop, completely ignoring the surrounding crowd, leaning forward across a small table to maintain intense, warm eye contact with their conversation partner

archetypes.name: High-Stakes Interactive Flow State
archetypes.core_difference: Dynamic, high-adrenaline concentration where the subject is physically locked-in and reacting to fast-paced external stimuli
archetypes.visual_elements: Video game controller or musical instrument, intense stare, tense and rigid posture, sitting at the edge of a seat, neon gaming lights or stage lighting, sweat
archetypes.text_query: An image showing an esports player gripping a controller tightly, sitting at the very edge of their seat under neon lights, staring unblinkingly at a monitor with extreme focus and a tense posture

emotions.definition: Feelings of favourable opinion or judgement; respect; admiration; gratefulness

archetypes.name: Formal Professional Recognition
archetypes.core_difference: Public, institutional validation and success in a brightly lit, formal indoor setting
archetypes.visual_elements: Stage, wooden podium, business suits, award plaque or certificate, firm handshake, smiling faces, bright spotlights, clapping audience in the background
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a proud mentor in a sharp suit shaking hands with a young professional on a brightly lit stage, handing them an award plaque while an audience claps in the background

archetypes.name: Intergenerational Reverence
archetypes.core_difference: Intimate, quiet, and personal respect between individuals of vastly different ages in a private, domestic space
archetypes.visual_elements: Young adult, elderly person, wrinkled hands, gentle touch, warm natural sunlight, cozy living room furniture, soft and tender facial expressions
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a young woman gently holding the hands of an elderly man in a cozy living room bathed in warm afternoon sunlight, looking at him with a soft smile of deep gratitude

archetypes.name: The Standing Ovation
archetypes.core_difference: Massive, collective expression of awe and admiration from a large crowd directed toward a single, distant focal point
archetypes.visual_elements: Large crowded theater, tiered seating, people standing up, clapping hands, faces angled upwards, dim ambient lighting, bright stage illumination in the distance
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a massive theater audience standing up in the dimly lit rows, clapping their hands enthusiastically while looking up with awe and admiration toward a brightly illuminated stage

archetypes.name: Somber Memorial Tribute
archetypes.core_difference: Respectful gratefulness and deep, quiet reverence in an outdoor, serious, and historically or culturally significant context
archetypes.visual_elements: Engraved stone monument, wreath of flowers, military uniform or dark winter coat, bowed head, salute, overcast sky, quiet park environment
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a lone person in a dark coat standing with their head bowed in quiet reverence, placing a vibrant floral wreath at the base of an engraved stone monument under a cloudy sky

emotions.definition: Feeling enthusiasm; stimulated; energetic

archetypes.name: High-Speed Adrenaline and Thrill
archetypes.core_difference: High-kinetic, outdoor environments where excitement is a direct physiological reaction to thrilling physical movement and speed
archetypes.visual_elements: Roller coaster car, motion-blurred background, raised hands, wind-blown hair, open-mouthed screaming smiles, clear blue sky, metal tracks
archetypes.text_query: A photo of people riding a fast roller coaster with their hands raised in the air, wind-blown hair, and wide-open screaming smiles against a bright blue sky, capturing intense adrenaline and thrill

archetypes.name: Triumphant Sporting Victory
archetypes.core_difference: Group dynamics in a structured, competitive setting, characterized by shared physical celebration and athletic context
archetypes.visual_elements: Team uniforms, grassy field or court, teammates hugging, jumping in the air, raised fists, sweat, stadium seating in the background, bright floodlights
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a group of athletes in dirt-stained uniforms jumping and tightly hugging each other on a bright green field, with raised fists and ecstatic facial expressions celebrating a major victory

archetypes.name: Intimate Domestic Surprise
archetypes.core_difference: Quiet, well-lit indoor setting emphasizing a deeply personal, focused reaction to a sudden positive revelation
archetypes.visual_elements: Living room couch, torn wrapping paper, open cardboard box or glowing laptop screen, wide gasping eyes, hands covering mouth, warm indoor lighting, casual clothing
archetypes.text_query: A photo of a person sitting on a cozy living room couch, hands covering their open mouth in a joyful gasp, looking down at a newly opened cardboard box surrounded by colorful torn wrapping paper

archetypes.name: Vibrant Nightlife Spectacle
archetypes.core_difference: Nocturnal, densely packed social environment dominated by dark shadows, artificial lighting, and collective, rhythmic euphoria
archetypes.visual_elements: Dark background, vibrant neon lasers, dense silhouettes of a crowd, glowing wristbands, raised hands facing a central stage, energetic dancing, atmospheric smoke
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a densely packed crowd at a night music festival, with silhouettes of energetic dancing people raising glowing wristbands and hands toward a stage illuminated by vibrant neon lasers and smoke

emotions.definition: Weariness; tiredness; sleepy

archetypes.name: The Late-Night Knowledge Worker
archetypes.core_difference: Mental exhaustion and screen-fatigue in an indoor, sedentary, low-light environment
archetypes.visual_elements: Glowing laptop screen, dark room, rubbing eyes, slumped posture, face resting in hands, empty coffee mugs, office desk, artificial blue light
archetypes.text_query: A photo of an office worker slumped over a desk in a darkened room, rubbing their eyes under the blue glow of a laptop monitor, surrounded by empty coffee cups and scattered paperwork

archetypes.name: Post-Exertion Physical Depletion
archetypes.core_difference: Acute, bodily exhaustion and muscle fatigue in a bright, active, physical environment
archetypes.visual_elements: Outdoor running track or gym, sports apparel, sweating profusely, hands resting on knees, dropped equipment, heavy breathing, harsh sunlight, flushed skin
archetypes.text_query: An image showing a sweaty athlete hunched over with hands resting on their knees on an outdoor running track, breathing heavily with a dropped water bottle resting on the sunlit ground beside them

archetypes.name: The Overwhelmed Caregiver
archetypes.core_difference: Chronic, chaotic domestic weariness characterized by clutter and a lack of personal space
archetypes.visual_elements: Messy living room, scattered plastic toys, adult slumped back on a fabric couch, disheveled hair, blank stare, soft daylight, casual loungewear, piles of laundry
archetypes.text_query: A photo of an exhausted parent with disheveled hair staring blankly while slumped heavily back on a living room couch, completely surrounded by scattered brightly colored children's toys and folded laundry
